folder_note: order 1.1 says only v1-folder/addendum1/; tables/figures go under the docs addendum1 folder (the order's tables/addendum1 and figures/addendum1 paths are read relative to it)

places.frame: B0_b10__LoD2 local frame = GTJUDGE addendum11 final_data reference__xyz

south_wall.offset_rule: d = (xy - p0).n_out: +2 m in front (outside) to -5 m behind; wall face d = 0; behind-wall result point = d < -0.64
south_wall.missing_part: GT rows in the zone with case_id 4 (영상 깊이 결측)
south_wall.valid_part: GT rows in the zone with case_id 0 (두 자료 모두 유효)
south_wall.corners: zone corners on the wall face: along 0.7/19.3 x z -43.3/-25.0 at d = 0

long_wall.axis: -n_out (the wall runs from the corner in the -n_out direction)
long_wall.n_out: +e (outside = continuing the south-wall direction beyond the corner)
long_wall.corners: along 5/25 x z -43.3/-25.0 at the face (offset 0)

annex_roof_edge.z_rule: centre z +/- 2 m (the order gives only XY)

back_wall_bottom.corners: the two centres +/- 2 m along their connecting horizontal direction (4 points at their z)

places.check: GT wall points of the zone must cluster at d ~ 0; reported in tables/place_check.csv; if not, the nearest wall plane is fitted and reported first

visibility_a1.rule: inside the image, z > 0, and the camera-to-point ray is not hit more than tau (the point's tau) before the point by (1) the site MVS mesh (AXES71 mvs/<site>/mesh_mvs_a.ply), (2) the site prior mesh (STAGE1 defs/<site>/prior_<prior>.npz V,F), (3) the arm's trained mesh. Result points: hits within 0.1 m of the point never block (tau > 0.1 already covers it)
visibility_a1.coverage_note: the MVS mesh and the ALS prior mesh cover the unit box only (buildings outside the box are missing); the LoD2 prior mesh holds whole buildings and reaches outside the box
visibility_a1.rule_check: c3 control result points: share of seen views whose render depth reproduces the result surface (|n.(X_v - p)| <= tau); PASS >= 90 %; reported first, never stops
visibility_a1.facing: angle between point-to-camera direction and the reference normal (result points: stored reference-aligned normal) <= 30 deg
visibility_a1.pixel: floor(K X / z + 0.5) on the 1024x741 training camera (same as v1)

work_ga.points_for_selection: GT rows (rows.npz) of the place; visibility_a1 with the own arm's trained mesh
work_ga.select: per place the training image with most seen place points among facing views and among oblique views; ties smaller image name
work_ga.camera: full-resolution FULL_OPENCV camera of the training image (FINALTRAIN inherited_judgeapply Cameras), photo from p0-audit raw Images.zip; crop undistorted with the GTJUDGE addendum9 undistort_crop rule to 1600x1280 (pinhole fx,fy,cx,cy of the same camera); 3D points projected with the same pinhole
work_ga.crop: GTJUDGE addendum9 bounds_crop (aspect 1.25, padding 1.06) around the projected seen place points
work_ga.points_overlay: seen GT rows coloured by case (addendum6 case_colors), c1 own lost points blue (#1F5FD6), c3 own wrong result points red (#D62728); only seen points (visibility_a1)
work_ga.surfaces: own arm trained mesh and own target surface (judgment_mesh) ray cast per crop pixel; colour = GTJUDGE addendum6 palette (result minus reference along the oriented triangle normal, cylinder query; white within tau, red above, blue below, saturation 1 m, no reference #8C95A3)
work_ga.arm: own (본 방법 판정): the red points are own-arm result points
work_ga.corner_marks: small crosses at the place corners (places.*.corners)
work_ga.legend: one separate legend image, no text inside the photo figures

arms.gt: five (B173nb_b10__LoD2 has no A1 run: 없음)

work_ra.completeness_points: GT rows within tau on the arm's target surface (addendum11 reference__<target>__within_tau1); > 200000 -> random 200000 (seed 20261111); outcome = within tau on the trained mesh

point_values.applied_views: seen views with map owner == point column patch row
point_values.supervision: sum of map weights over applied views
point_values.weight_median: median map weight over applied views
point_values.bound_opacity: max opacity among Gaussians bound (target_tag 1) to the point's column patch with |n.(x-p)| <= tau; none = '없음'

work_ra.accuracy_patches: per prior patch (valid target row): trained-mesh result samples (eligible_new) whose column owner maps to the patch; outcome = share outside tau; target-surface share from the target-mesh result samples the same way

patch_values.supervision: sum over all training views of the map weights of pixels owned by the patch / patch area
patch_values.bound: count, max and median opacity of Gaussians bound to the patch at 30000

bins.deciles: per scene x arm x case, value deciles (quantile edges, ties merged); '없음' its own bin
bins.two_axis: applied views x weight median quintiles (5x5)
bins.pooled: all scenes pooled with the same bins computed on the pooled values

work_ra.figures: per scene x arm: outcome vs supervision (log x) by case; outcome by opacity bin bars; R1 ALS and R1 LoD2 top maps (supervision, bound opacity, outcome)

work_da.points: v1 sets c2 lost and control (R1rep_b10__ALS)
work_da.remain: v1 3-바 test for every point (bound to the column patch with |n.(x-p)| <= tau)
work_da.order: seen views (v1 rule): share where the drawer (v1 render, max alpha*T) is closer to the camera than the nearest remaining bound Gaussian (camera z of centres)
work_da.refsim: check6 refsim_<arm>_bg model: per lost-point seen view render depth class: floor (|d| <= tau), other surface, empty (alpha < 0.5)

work_na.recount: B0 c1 and c3 checks 2-4 with visibility_a1 (v1 rules, orders, thresholds); control points too; tables suffix _a1; c1 split by place (annex_roof_edge, back_wall_bottom, other)

south_wall_sets.behind: trained result samples in the zone with eligible_new and not within tau and d < -0.64
south_wall_sets.face: zone result samples eligible_new and within tau

work_na.observation: GT rows on the two wall faces (|d| <= tau_wall and wall flag): seen views (visibility_a1), incidence angle (min, median), applied views, weight median, render-depth offset along the wall normal (behind positive; median per point; also by incidence 0-30/30-60/>60)
work_na.opacity: patches whose target lies in the wall zone (|d_target| <= 1 m): bound Gaussians count, per m2, opacity bins and median; retained share from initial seeds (init_id of the patch seeds still bound to the same patch); patch area share with no bound Gaussian; split south wall case 0 / case 4 by the patch's GT rows majority
work_na.code_check: file:line list of opacity reset, opacity/size pruning, clone/split paths and any bound/unbound distinction in r23/r25
work_na.baseline: RESCORE addendum3_stage2 B0_b10__LoD2__baseline_30000 with addendum11 stored distances

points_files: npz per work (parquet engine not available); > 200 MB -> random 200000 rows
